## Summary

What would you like OpenClaude to do?

## Problem

What problem does this solve for you?

## Proposed Direction

Describe the smallest useful version of the feature if possible.

## Alternatives Considered

What are you doing today instead?

## Prior Art / Primary Sources

Link official docs, original repositories, papers, standards, patents, or maintained implementations if they shaped the request. Blog posts are useful only as pointers to primary sources.

## Claim Boundary / Protected Actions

- [ ] This request can start as bounded internal no-provider planning or local evidence work.
- [ ] I understand this request does not itself authorize provider calls, live model calls, external service calls, dependency installs, deploy, publish, launch, production mutation, MFH mutation, real product repo mutation, canonical memory/governance writes, or release/public/production/external/autonomous reliability claims.

## Additional Context

Examples, screenshots, related projects, or prior art.
